# flagged for the user's review (decision DH-2). Generated by

# The body: skin, face and hair (loose hair lags a frame), in linen underclothes.

anim.call: frames 6, ticks 10, loop
anim.down: frames 2, ticks 24, loop
anim.carried: frames 6, ticks 5, loop
event.footstep: walk 0, walk 3, run 0, run 4
pose.down: lying
pose.carried: carried
